mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_record (user_id, change_score, reason, action_type, credit_before, credit_after, credit_level, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeScore}, #{reason}, #{actionType}, #{creditBefore}, #{creditAfter}, #{creditLevel}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND change_score < 0 AND action_type IN ('late', 'absent', 'bad_rating')
